import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 510;
    static long dp_con[] = new long[maxn];
    static long sum_con[] = new long[maxn];
    static long dp[][] = new long[maxn][maxn];
    static long sum[][] = new long[maxn][maxn];
    static int c[][] = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int n, m, mod;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            c[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        dp_con[1] = 2;
        dp_con[0] = 1;
        sum_con[1] = sum_con[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) {
            dp_con[i] = 0;
            sum_con[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                long rcon = (dp_con[j] * dp_con[i - j - 1] % mod * c[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                dp_con[i] = (dp_con[i] + rcon * (i + 1)) % mod;
                sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + (dp_con[j] * sum_con[i - j - 1] + sum_con[j] * dp_con[i - j - 1]) % mod * c[i - 1][j] % mod * (i + 1)) % mod;
                sum_con[i] = (sum_con[i] + rcon * (i - 1 + j) * (j + 1) / 2 % mod) % mod;
            }
            dp_con[i] %= mod;
            sum_con[i] %= mod;
        }

        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) if (dp[i][j] != 0) {
            for (int k = 1; k + i <= m; k++) {
                dp[i + k][j + 1] = (dp[i + k][j + 1] + dp[i][j] * dp_con[k] % mod * c[i + k][k]) % mod;
                sum[i + k][j + 1] = (sum[i + k][j + 1] + (dp[i][j] * sum_con[k] + sum[i][j] * dp_con[k]) % mod * c[i + k][k]) % mod;
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if (n - (m - 1 + j) < 0) break;
            ans = (ans + sum[m][j] * c[n - (m - 1 + j) + j][j] % mod) % mod;
        }

        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }
}
